profile.headline: Sr. Principal Web  Developer at Epicor Software Corp
profile.summary:
•	Over 15+ years of experience in all phases of Software Development and Support of Web Based Applications.
•	Involved in complete SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle) including architecture, analysis, design, development, implementation, testing, documentation with Pseudo Code and maintenance of Client/Server and web based applications
•	Analysis, Design, develop, deploy, and support custom and out-of-the-box solutions using SHAREPOINT  2007/2010/2013 and SHAREPOINT Designer 2010/2013, SharePoint design manager 2013 and also experienced with Windows Power Shell scripting
•	Developed SHAREPOINT Features, Custom WEB PARTS, Aspx Forms, InfoPath Forms, Custom Master Pages and Workflows. 
•	Great experience with Creating InfoPath Forms, building rules, publishing to SharePoint Lists and also Handling Events for SharePoint Lists, Libraries and Workflows
•	Experienced with Event Receivers for various lists in SharePoint
•	Experienced in developing Enterprise reports using Crystal Reports and Sql Server Reporting Services SSRS
•	Involved in design and developing workflows using Nintex tool and SharePoint Designer 2010/2013
•	Excellent work experience on Microsoft Dot Net technologies in developing of many Web applications using C#.Net, Silverlight, Vb.Net, VBA, Asp, VB, C++,Asp.Net, Ado.Net, Sql Server 2000/2005/2008, Crystal Reports with MS Visual Studio.Net
•	Project version tracking control using Visual Source Safe, TFS (Team Foundation Server)
•	Extensively worked with Stored Procedures, Functions and Triggers using Microsoft SQL Server 2000/2005/2008/2012
•	Have been worked with MS Access applications with VBA code
•	Delivering and implementing the project as per scheduled deadlines and extending post-implementation and maintenance support to the client
•	Extensively worked with EKTRON CMS developing Custom Templates, Widgets, asp.NET utilities, Custom Wireframes, SQL Scripts, Administration Features and DxH components.

positions.title: Sr. Principal Web Developer
positions.description:
To provide support and development to all the internal and external web sites such as 
EPICnet(Intranet – SharePoint 2010), EPICweb (Extranet - SharePoint 2013), Epicor.com (company portal – Ektron CMS ).
Collaborate with all the business units in order to provide solutions for their special projects based on SharePoint web parts, InfoPath Forms, Nintex Workflows. Examples: eBOPO Process (tool based on InfoPath that gathers all the information required to process an eBOPO using a complex approval workflow based on the different PO types), Subcontractor Invoice Library ( tool based on InfoPath, 

Key Achievements
	Epicor.com upgrade from SharePoint 2010 to Ektron CMS portal.

	EPICnet upgrade from SharePoint 2007 – SharePoint 2010
	EPICweb update from SharePoint 2007 – SharePoint 2013
	PowerShell Scripts to monitoring Ektron CMS
	Change Control Process Form and Approval Workflow
	Credit Memo Form and Approval Workflow
	Subcontractor Library Form and Approval Workflow
	eBOPO Form and Approval Workflow
	InfoPath forms and Nintex Workflows developed for the BU.

positions.title: Sr. Specialist Applications
positions.description:
Recruited to establish a Centralized Report repository environment so consulting manager and executives could have visibility of how their projects are and take actions based on that information. Collaborate with Professional Services Consultants and with Regional Consulting Managers in order to provide tools to make their work easier. Examples Statement of Work Generator (tool based on InfoPath that quotes all the professional services before they create a proposal to the customer)
Provide Support to the SharePoint intranet developing new applications  using different technologies such as InfoPath, Nintex Workflows, etc.
Key Achievements
	Customizations to the company implementation of Epicor for Services Enterprises
	Create a Report Center based on MS Reporting Services with more than 30 Reports to serve worldwide managers extracting information from our Professional Services database. 
	Create a Statement of Work application using InfoPath and SharePoint services, this application creates a full editable word document using as a data source all the information provided in a quoting InfoPath application.
	Create and apply hot fixes and customizations to the Internal Professional Services Software.
	Migration of SharePoint lists into SQL data tables so we can create Reports using SSRS.
	Migration Project from SharePoint 2007 to SharePoint 2013
	InfoPath forms and Nintex Workflows developed for the BU.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Recruited to create internal web applications development and the generation of tools to improve business process, help business analyst to identify opportunity areas and create web applications that satisfy that needs. 
Key Achievements
	Create a Rating Application to provide and generate the billing with all the telephony services used by a customer.
	Create an online application to be able to receive credit card payments and transfer all the transactions into the Billing System.
	Create a Human Resources Intranet to provide paychecks and internal information to the employees.
	Create a Report Tool to generate all the Invoices and be able to print and send them to the final users

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Recruited to lead a small team (5) of developers with the objective of implementing custom web applications for customers and subsidiaries of Grupo Multimedios. 

Key Achievements
	Create the first version of the online newspaper Milenio.com .
	Create several web sites for Multimedios Estrellas de Oro Corporation including: Multimedios.net, MMenlinea.com , Multimedios.tv, Intercable.net, Cablevision.com.mx , etc.
	Provide support to all the SQL back end requirements for an in-house ERP that Multimedios Estrellas de Oro is using now.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Recruited to participate in the development of internal tools and assets that would support the growth of the IT consulting practice.

Key Achievements
	Participation in Analysis, Design and Development of catalogs integration project.
